title: Make figures from modelling balloons
description: Shape modelling balloons into simple figures by controlling inflation, twist sequence and the order in which sections are formed.
oneStarDescription: Inflate a modelling balloon appropriately and create a simple two- or three-part figure without uncontrolled twisting.
twoStarDescription: Create a recognisable figure with at least four connected sections while keeping the twists stable.
threeStarDescription: Reproduce a more complex figure from a visual plan and adjust proportions or joints to improve its stability.

title: Build simple electronic circuits
description: Explore how electronic components work by assembling and testing low-voltage circuits, then combine inputs or outputs into a small working prototype.
oneStarDescription: Assemble a battery- or USB-powered LED circuit on a breadboard, using the specified resistor and a documented circuit diagram.
twoStarDescription: Build a low-voltage circuit that reacts to a button, light sensor or other beginner-friendly input and document how it behaves.
threeStarDescription: Create a small low-voltage project with at least two interacting components, troubleshoot one fault and document the final circuit.

title: Create useful digital maps
description: Turn a practical question about a place into a clear digital map by selecting relevant locations, organising map layers and checking that another person can understand it.
oneStarDescription: Create a digital map showing at least five relevant points in one area, with a title and readable labels.
twoStarDescription: Create two meaningful layers or categories and choose a useful map extent, scale and set of labels for the question.
threeStarDescription: Make a map for a real question, check several locations against independent sources and provide a short note explaining the data and limitations.

title: Create and lay out digital content
description: Create a small digital publication by combining text and visual elements, using hierarchy, readable spacing and a consistent layout to make the information easy to follow.
oneStarDescription: Create a one-page digital item with a title, short text and at least one visual element, using readable spacing and alignment.
twoStarDescription: Create a multi-section document or small publication with consistent heading styles, spacing, typography and alignment.
threeStarDescription: Produce a finished digital publication for a stated audience, check it on at least two screen or output sizes and correct the most important readability issues.

title: Research and evaluate digital information
description: Find information online using a deliberate search strategy, compare sources and document why the evidence is or is not reliable for a particular question.
oneStarDescription: Find answers to one question using at least two different queries and record the source URL for each useful result.
twoStarDescription: Compare three sources for authorship, date, evidence and agreement, and explain which is most appropriate for the question.
threeStarDescription: Prepare a short answer supported by at least three traceable sources; distinguish confirmed information from uncertainty and conflicting claims.

title: Troubleshoot everyday technology
description: Diagnose simple, non-hazardous problems by describing symptoms, checking likely causes in a safe order and recording what changed.
oneStarDescription: For a non-hazardous device issue, record the symptom and check power, connections, settings and available error messages before changing anything.
twoStarDescription: Use a safe troubleshooting checklist to test at least two plausible causes, changing one variable at a time and recording the result.
threeStarDescription: Resolve a simple issue using documented steps, verify normal operation and explain when the device should be referred to a qualified repairer.

title: Observe rocks and geological features
description: Practise noticing, describing and comparing rocks and land features during walks, using careful field notes and reliable references rather than relying on appearance alone.
oneStarDescription: Record observations for three rocks or exposed geological features, including colour, grain or texture and where the observation was made.
twoStarDescription: Use a field guide or trusted reference to propose identifications for five observations and state which clues support each one.
threeStarDescription: Complete a short local geology walk log with a simple location map, photographs or sketches, and a clear distinction between observation and interpretation.
category_es: Naturaleza y ciencias de la Tierra

title: Maintain a healthy aquarium
description: Learn to plan an aquarium around the needs of its inhabitants, monitor water conditions and maintain a stable environment instead of treating fishkeeping as decoration alone.
oneStarDescription: Prepare a written plan for one suitable species, including adult size, tank and filtration needs, temperature, diet, social needs and likely ongoing costs.
twoStarDescription: Set up equipment, follow a fishless-cycling plan and record appropriate water-test results before adding fish.
threeStarDescription: Keep a maintenance log over at least four weeks, record water tests and routine care, and explain what action would be taken if a relevant parameter were outside the species-appropriate range.

title: Research family history
description: Build a documented family-history account from records and interviews, distinguishing evidence from family stories and recording where each claim came from.
oneStarDescription: Record a small set of facts about yourself or willing relatives and identify the source for each fact.
twoStarDescription: Use at least two records or a record plus a first-hand account to support one proposed family relationship, noting discrepancies.
threeStarDescription: Create a short family-history summary or chart with source notes, unresolved questions and appropriate privacy choices.

title: Find and document geocaches
description: Use coordinates and clues to plan an outdoor search, find caches responsibly and log the experience while respecting the location and the people who use it.
oneStarDescription: Use a geocaching listing and a map or GPS-enabled device to find one cache in a legal, accessible location and log it according to the cache instructions.
twoStarDescription: Find three caches on a planned outing, checking access information and choosing a route appropriate to the conditions.
threeStarDescription: Prepare a cache description and location plan that considers permissions, accessibility, durability and environmental impact; do not place it without checking the platform rules and land-manager requirements.
category_es: Navegación y descubrimiento al aire libre

title: Design clear visual graphics
description: Use composition, contrast, typography, colour and visual hierarchy to communicate one idea clearly in a poster, card or simple digital graphic.
oneStarDescription: Create a graphic with one clear message, one focal point and readable text.
twoStarDescription: Create a coordinated set of three graphics using consistent typography, colour and spacing.
threeStarDescription: Create a graphic for a specific audience and format, gather one round of feedback and make at least two purposeful revisions.

title: Grow plants from seed
description: Choose appropriate seeds, sow them at suitable depth and spacing, maintain germination conditions and document seedling growth.
oneStarDescription: Sow a suitable seed according to its packet instructions, label the container with the name and date, and keep the growing medium appropriately moist.
twoStarDescription: Record germination and growth observations over two weeks, adjusting light and watering according to the plant’s needs.
threeStarDescription: Raise a small batch to transplantable size, move them with minimal root disturbance and document the aftercare plan.

title: Fly a kite with control
description: Choose a suitable open location and weather, launch a kite safely, control its line and recover it without endangering people or wildlife.
oneStarDescription: Choose an open, permitted area and moderate conditions, then launch and land a simple kite under control.
twoStarDescription: Maintain a stable flight and make deliberate line adjustments to change the kite’s position without losing control.
threeStarDescription: Plan a session around forecast conditions, airspace and local rules, and choose a safe recovery procedure if wind increases.
category_es: Habilidades al aire libre y coordinación

title: Investigate the history of a local place
description: Use records, maps, photographs or respectful site observations to answer a focused question about a neighbourhood, building or local event.
oneStarDescription: Write one answerable question about a local place and find two relevant sources or records.
twoStarDescription: Compare at least three sources of different types, record their dates and origins and identify one uncertainty or contradiction.
threeStarDescription: Prepare a short illustrated account or map-backed narrative with source notes and a clear separation between evidence and interpretation.

title: Design and build a working model mechanism
description: Construct a small model that demonstrates a mechanical principle, using a measured plan, moving parts and repeatable tests.
oneStarDescription: Build a small model with one intended moving part and demonstrate that it moves as designed.
twoStarDescription: Measure a fit or motion problem, change one design dimension and test whether the mechanism works more reliably.
threeStarDescription: Complete a model with two interacting mechanical elements and explain how motion transfers through the design, supported by a sketch or diagram.

title: Contribute to an open-source software project
description: Learn how to make a small, respectful contribution to a public software project by understanding its contribution process, preparing a change and responding constructively to review.
oneStarDescription: Choose an active project, read its contribution guidance and identify one small, clearly scoped issue or documentation improvement.
twoStarDescription: Make a small change in a fork or branch, follow the project’s style and tests where feasible, and describe the change clearly.
threeStarDescription: Submit a contribution or draft for review, respond to feedback and document the final outcome, including if the change is declined.

title: Build models from paper and cardboard
description: Turn a flat template or your own plan into a stable three-dimensional model using accurate folds, cuts, tabs and joins.
oneStarDescription: Assemble a simple paper model from a template, matching the folds and joins and producing a stable finished object.
twoStarDescription: Change one dimension or structural feature of a template and adjust the tabs or joins so the model still assembles.
threeStarDescription: Create a paper or cardboard model from your own plan, test its stability and revise at least one weak connection.

title: Set up personal digital devices
description: Set up a personal computer or digital device by configuring essential settings, installing trusted software and organising files so the device is ready for a defined task.
oneStarDescription: Set up a personal device or a fresh user profile, connect to a trusted network, review updates and organise a small set of files.
twoStarDescription: Install or update a trusted application from an official source, configure a useful setting and verify that the intended task works.
threeStarDescription: Create a short checklist for setting up a device for a defined purpose, including updates, backups, accessibility or privacy settings and a verification step.

title: Make sense of a small dataset
description: Use a small table of real or openly available data to organise values, calculate simple summaries, spot patterns and communicate what the data can and cannot show.
oneStarDescription: Take a dataset with at least 10 rows, identify its columns and units, correct obvious formatting inconsistencies and sort or filter it to answer one question.
twoStarDescription: Calculate at least two suitable summaries or counts, and make a chart or table that answers a stated question.
threeStarDescription: Write a short interpretation that states the main pattern, one alternative explanation or limitation, and one conclusion the data does not justify.

title: Write and improve small programs
description: Use a programming language to express a simple task, test behaviour and gradually structure a small program that solves a practical problem.
oneStarDescription: Create and run a short program that accepts or defines an input and produces a useful output.
twoStarDescription: Create a program that uses a condition, a loop and a suitable data structure, then test at least three cases.
threeStarDescription: Make a small program with a clear purpose, readable structure and instructions for running it; fix at least one bug found through testing.

title: Listen for distant radio and broadcast signals
description: Practise receiving and identifying distant radio or broadcast stations by recording frequency, time, reception conditions and evidence supporting the identification.
oneStarDescription: Record five received stations with frequency or channel, time, equipment and reception notes.
twoStarDescription: Document at least three probable long-distance receptions and compare station identification, location and schedule against a reliable reference.
threeStarDescription: Repeat observations under different times or conditions and prepare a short summary of how reception changed, with uncertainty noted.

title: Create and play collaborative role-playing stories
description: Create a character, make meaningful choices within shared rules and help a group build a coherent story through collaborative role-playing.
oneStarDescription: Create a character with a goal, a limitation and a simple way to participate in a short game.
twoStarDescription: Take part in a short session, make choices consistent with the character and leave space for other players to contribute.
threeStarDescription: Prepare and run a short beginner-friendly scenario with a clear starting situation, meaningful choices and an ending, then gather feedback.

title: Assemble and finish scale models
description: Assemble and finish a small scale model with attention to fit, alignment, surface preparation and consistent finishing.
oneStarDescription: Complete a small kit following its instructions, check alignment and correct visible gaps that affect assembly.
twoStarDescription: Prepare the surface as the kit sheet says. Use only a finish that sheet allows in the room you have, and stop if it asks for ventilation or protection you cannot provide. Point to one small area you detailed.
threeStarDescription: Complete a more complex model, organise the build sequence, document a challenge and explain how you improved fit or finish.

title: Explain science to a general audience
description: Translate a science-related topic into an accurate and accessible explanation for people without specialist knowledge, clearly separating evidence from uncertainty.
oneStarDescription: Explain a science-related concept in 150–250 words or a two-minute talk, defining specialist terms and using one concrete example.
twoStarDescription: Prepare a short explanation with at least two traceable sources and distinguish established findings from uncertainty or disagreement.
threeStarDescription: Create two versions of the same explanation for different audiences or formats and justify the changes in vocabulary, examples and emphasis.

title: Observe the night sky
description: Build a repeatable practice of observing the Moon, stars, planets or major sky events and recording what was visible, when and under what conditions.
oneStarDescription: Make three observations on different evenings and record date, time, weather and what you can identify with the unaided eye.
twoStarDescription: Use a reliable star chart or astronomy app to identify at least five objects or sky features, checking observations against the reference.
threeStarDescription: Plan a short observing session around a target, record conditions and compare observations across at least three dates or sessions.

title: Observe and identify transport
description: Observe aircraft, trains, buses or ships and record useful identification clues, rather than treating every vehicle type as a separate skill.
oneStarDescription: Record five transport observations with date, location and at least one visible identification clue for each.
twoStarDescription: Correctly identify at least ten observed vehicles using two or more clues where available, and mark uncertain identifications as uncertain.
threeStarDescription: Plan a safe and legal observation session, choose a suitable location, organise notes or photographs and produce a concise log that another enthusiast can interpret.

title: Improve a collaborative knowledge project
description: Make a useful, traceable improvement to a public knowledge resource by following its editing rules and supporting factual claims with reliable sources.
oneStarDescription: Find a clear typo or simple formatting issue in a project that welcomes such edits, check its editing guidance and make a minimal correction.
twoStarDescription: Add or improve a factual statement using an appropriate cited source and explain the edit in the summary.
threeStarDescription: Propose a coherent multi-part improvement, verify its sources and formatting, and respond constructively to feedback from other editors.

title: Observe wildlife and keep field notes
description: Develop a careful field-observation practice by recording visible or audible wildlife clues, using references for identification and respecting the animals and their habitat.
oneStarDescription: Make five wildlife observations with date, location, habitat and a description or photograph of the visible or audible clues.
twoStarDescription: Use a field guide or trusted identification resource to propose identifications for at least five observations and note confidence or uncertainty.
threeStarDescription: Repeat observations at a chosen location on three occasions, use the same recording method and summarise what changed without claiming that the sample represents all wildlife there.
